evals.input: We just agreed on a deal with a TikTok creator (28k followers, cooking niche) to promote our meal kit service. Write the brief.
expect: Includes all required sections: overview, audience, key message, deliverables, messaging direction, FTC disclosure
FTC disclosure is explicit about TikTok's 'Paid partnership' label and verbal/text disclosure requirement
Deliverables section specifies platform, format, length, due date, go-live date
Do/Don't list is short — 3–5 items max, not a script
Leaves creative room for the creator

evals.input: What FTC disclosure is required for a paid Instagram Reel?
expect: States that #ad or #sponsored must be visible in the caption, not buried in hashtags
